executable.title: Non-Local Means Filter CLI
executable.description: Denoises a volume with the scikit-image non-local means filter, in full 3D or slice by slice.

string-enumeration.name: mode
string-enumeration.label: Mode
string-enumeration.description: Filter the full volume in 3D, or each axial slice independently in 2D.

double.name: strength
double.label: Strength
double.description: Filter strength h as a multiple of the noise standard deviation.

double.name: sigma
double.label: Noise standard deviation
double.description: Noise standard deviation in intensity units. Zero estimates it from the volume.

integer.name: patchSize
integer.label: Patch size
integer.description: Side, in voxels, of the patches compared to compute weights.

integer.name: patchDistance
integer.label: Search distance
integer.description: Maximal distance, in voxels, to search for similar patches.

boolean.name: fastMode
boolean.label: Fast mode
boolean.description: Use the faster, box-weighted patch distance.

string.name: nullValue
string.label: Null value
string.description: Voxels with this value are kept unchanged. Empty if the volume has no null value.

double.name: usedSigma
double.label: Noise standard deviation used
double.description: Noise standard deviation used by the filter, estimated or given.

double.name: usedH
double.label: Filter strength used
double.description: Filter strength h used by the filter, in intensity units.
